correctness.rationale: Partition configurations AA, AB, BB of sizes binom(m,2),mn,binom(n,2), degrees 2n,t-2,2m. Unsigned complete-graph incidence T_r has T_rT_r^T=(r-2)I+J and rank r for r>=3, giving two kernel eigenspaces; tensor zero-sum AB gives eigenvalue t-2, symmetric standard-direction 2x2 blocks give factors (z-n)(z-m-2n+2) and their transposes, constants give eigenvalues 0,t,2t-2. Multiplicities sum to binom(m+n,2). Matrix-tree product / binom(t,2) yields factor 4 and stated count. Inspected two independent program constructions; fresh independent Laplacian eigenvalue and exact cofactor tests (3,3),(3,4),(4,4). Infinite parameter theorem follows from invariant-space proof, not finite tests.
